title: Hölder's inequality for Boolean functions
statement:
Let $p > 1$ and let $f, h : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be Boolean functions, with expectations taken under the uniform measure on $\{0,1\}^n$. Then their $L^2$ inner product satisfies
\[
  \langle f, h\rangle \;\le\; \bigl(\E\bigl[\abs{f}^{p}\bigr]\bigr)^{1/p}\,
  \bigl(\E\bigl[\abs{h}^{p/(p-1)}\bigr]\bigr)^{(p-1)/p},
\]
where the exponents $p$ and $p/(p-1)$ are conjugate.
hypotheses_covered: f, h are Boolean functions on the n-dimensional hypercube
